_note: SYNTHETIC scenario modelled on the pattern described in the hackathon brief (outdoor roadside scene, burning, scene litter, two-wheeler, toll-plaza CCTV). Not real case data. No victim identity is used, in line with BNS 2023 s.72.
title: Roadside homicide with burning — culvert under service road
description:

Ex-A10: gutka packet and matchbox near the culvert entrance

Ex-A13: CCTV at toll plaza covering the service road, not yet seized
Ex-A14: 4 mobile phones seized from the accused
Ex-A15: clothes of accused seized at the instance of accused
